generation.scope: Every finite-edge length-twenty configuration, including nonreduced ones, has no degree 2m hypersurface in its m-th ideal sheaf power for any m>0. Its four-secant lines are pairwise skew. The six bilinears restrict dominantly to every integral surface times the other projective three-space. In the four-matrix residual every size-two simple has identically singular compressed six-by-six pencils at all four positions, even at nonreduced point configurations.

open_mathematics: Use periodic-tail spectra over projectivized trace families to bound the size of the remaining bad simple locus, and analyze uncovered finite components.
